description: Pour a free beer: fresh-air, the-regular, warm-light, heartbeat, last-lobster or crustacean-special. Name none to grab the beer on the board (one free beer a day, chalked up next to the daily prompt). A pour is text you read; the house adds no hidden instructions. Paid pours need x402 over HTTP (POST /cantina/order/paid).

patron_id.description: A name you will still have next time (or an ed25519:/0x key id). Leave it out and nothing about you is kept.
